department: Department of Epidemiology, Biostatistics and Occupational Health

deadline.value: December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027 (Fall intake only). Submit by about November 1 so referees have time.
deadline.quote: Deadline for Receipt of Completed Applications for Fall 2027 | December 1, 2026 (the application system will open September 15, 2026) | consider submitting by November 1 in order to give them ample time to respond

gre_subject.value: The department only says to send GRE results if applicable.

supervisor.value: The admissions page does not say whether PhD applicants need a supervisor first.

funding.value: PhD students in their first 4 years get at least the Faculty of Medicine minimum funding level if they stay in good standing, but must also apply for scholarships.
funding.quote: The School follows the Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences (FMHS) Graduate Student Funding amounts for Ph.D. students. | Doctoral students are required to seek funding to support themselves during their studies

entry_route.value: An MSc in statistics or biostatistics is expected; exceptional candidates may apply directly from a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: in addition to an M.Sc. degree in Statistics or Biostatistics will be considered for Ph.D. admission. Exceptional candidates who do not hold an M.Sc. may apply to directly the PhD program.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 5.0 on the new 6-point scale (100 on the old iBT scale for tests before January 2026); only TOEFL or IELTS accepted.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: As of January 2026 an overall score of 5 on the 6 ... point scale is required | A minimum score of 100 on the internet-based test will be accepted for tests taken prior to January 2026.

name: PhD in Biostatistics
